entry.title: Shisu-ko 0.2.0: live Whisper subtitles for YouTube with Yomitan text …
entry.content:
Shisu-ko 0.2.0: live Whisper subtitles for YouTube with Yomitan text and Anki mining

Firefox extension (addon/) that overlays Whisper-generated Japanese subtitles on the
YouTube player as real DOM text, pauses on hover for dictionary lookups, offers a
transcript panel, and mines screenshot + sentence audio into the newest Anki card via
AnkiConnect (or Downloads).

Local server (server/) built on faster-whisper and yt-dlp: transcribes from the
playhead forward in windows, caches cues per video, serves sentence clips as MP3,
picks int8 weights when GPU memory is scarce, and restarts cleanly after driver resets.

Docker image and compose files with GPU support, Windows wrappers for Docker Engine
inside WSL, setup/run scripts for the native install, and a README with setup,
Yomitan/Anki workflow, options and troubleshooting.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5.1 <noreply@anthropic.com>
